     ```

The incorrect loop condition could lead to accessing out-of-bounds memory, resulting in a segmentation fault when `BindPaths=` or `BindReadOnlyPaths=` is set. By correcting the loop condition, the patch resolves this issue, ensuring safe and correct execution of the function.
